paper_info.title: Possible Couplings of Dark Matter
paper_info.author: Kevin J. Ludwick
paper_info.status: Most recent paper from search results

detection_method_summary.focus: Non-gravitational interactions between dark matter and other fields
detection_method_summary.key_innovation: Avoids specifying explicit parametrization for dark matter-dark energy conversion rate Q

key_detection_techniques.gravitational_detection: Standard approach - dark matter detected only gravitationally so far
key_detection_techniques.direct_detection: Experiments looking for direct interaction with target materials - strongly constrained by non-observation
key_detection_techniques.indirect_detection: Detection of decay products (neutrinos via IceCube, cosmic rays via AMS-02)
key_detection_techniques.theoretical_coupling: Analysis of fundamental couplings without explicit parametrization

methodological_innovations.non_minimal_coupling: Coupling via Ricci scalar R necessary for scalar field renormalization in curved spacetime
methodological_innovations.slow_roll_approximation: Assumes slowly varying dark energy potential to enable analytical calculations
methodological_innovations.luminogenesis_model: Beyond Standard Model theory connecting dark matter uniquely to inflaton
methodological_innovations.astrophysical_constraints: Uses N-body simulations to constrain self-interacting dark matter masses

detection_constraints.self_interaction: Transfer cross section ⟨σT⟩/mX constraints from dwarf galaxies, Milky Way, and clusters
detection_constraints.mass_bounds: Dark matter mass mχ ≤ 1 TeV from astrophysical constraints

theoretical_framework.luminogenesis_model: Unifies dark and luminous sectors above Dark Unified Theory scale
theoretical_framework.symmetry_breaking: SU(6) → SU(4)DM × SU(2)L × U(1)DM triggered by inflaton
theoretical_framework.dark_matter_particles: CHIMPs (χ Massive Particles) formed from four χ particles via SU(4) confinement
theoretical_framework.yukawa_potential: V(r) = -αDM/r × e^(-mπDM×r) for CHIMP-dark pion interaction
